arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Verrilli argued Kentucky's procedures pose a danger of cruel executions.
Mr. Englert agreed that proper administration of the first drug prevents pain.
Chief Justice Roberts noted an expert agreed proper administration yields a humane death.
Justice Kennedy asked if an argument exists assuming perfect administration.
